truth.dmu_G_note: the planted +5 Msun is a HYPERPARAMETER of the draw (mu_G = 35 GAL / 40 AGN); the detected-set medians 36.813 / 41.557 Msun are descriptive only and are NOT the mark

tolerances.note: residuals are quoted in ULP of the compared value alongside the absolute bound; 15.7 is an exact equality, not a tolerance, and 15.4 is a bitwise check (one distinct hex per row)

logL_scale.note: 1 ULP of the ACTUAL |logL| of this mock; the registered tolerance table quotes 9.094947017729282e-13 at |lnL| ~ 4.2e3

15_1_both_marks_zero.description: two-mark at (dmu_chi, dmu_G) = (0, 0) against the shared-population K=2 model (8 labels, no _c2 population coordinate), same data object

15_2_mass_mark_zero.description: two-mark at dmu_G = 0 against the spin-only (Analysis-8) 9-label model, cell for cell on the shared (f, dmu_chi) lattice, on THIS events file

15_3_spin_mark_zero.description: with the spin mark OFF (dmu_chi = 0) the mass mark must still move logL at f = 0.357 and must be frozen at f = 0

15_4_f0_inert.description: f_AGN = 0: total, PE, selection and log_mu bitwise frozen over the 3 x 3 mark lattice

15_5_f1_live.description: f_AGN = 1: a distinct value per node in BOTH mark axes with the other held, in total / PE / selection / log_mu

15_6_gaussian_mean_liveness.description: MANDATORY.  |dlnL| for a 1 Msun step in dmu_G, in the PE term and the selection term SEPARATELY as well as in the total; registered threshold 1e-3

15_7_k1_endpoints.description: f = 0 equals a K=1 GAL build; f = 1 equals a K=1 AGN build whose pinned base block carries the AGN branch's own mu_G and mu_chi.  Registered as EXACTLY 0.0.
